name: Shared Album Screensaver
description: Turn Google Photos, OneDrive and iCloud shared albums into your Kiosk Satellite screensaver. Paste one or more album links and choose Shared Albums under Screensaver mode. Photos play in random order with smooth crossfades, separate crop settings for horizontal and vertical photos, optional slow zoom and date captions. No sign-in needed.
author: Coffmad

settings.title: Shared album links
settings.description: Paste a share link, or several separated by spaces to mix albums. Google Photos: Share > Create link. OneDrive: share a folder with "Anyone with the link". iCloud: in the shared album turn on Public Website. Work or school OneDrive is not supported.

settings.title: Check album for new photos every
settings.description: How often the album list is downloaded again to pick up added or removed photos.

settings.title: Only photos that match the screen
settings.description: Show vertical photos only on a portrait screen and horizontal photos only on a landscape screen. Square photos show on both. If no photo matches, every photo shows.

settings.title: Order
settings.description: Shuffle shows every photo once in random order before any repeats.

settings.title: Transition
settings.description: Cut sends one photo to the screen at a time, which leaves room for larger, sharper photos.

settings.title: Slow zoom
settings.description: Gently zoom each photo while it shows. Turn off on slower tablets if the motion stutters.

settings.title: Zoom amount
settings.description: How far each photo zooms in over its time on screen.

settings.title: Crop at most
settings.description: With Fill screen, a photo that would lose more than this share of its picture shows whole on a blurred background instead. A 4:3 photo on a 16:10 screen loses about 17%, a vertical photo on a landscape screen about 50%. 100% always crops.

settings.title: Keep in view when cropping
settings.description: Which part of a photo stays on screen when its top or bottom is cropped. Upper part keeps faces in most portrait photos.

settings.title: Plain background color
settings.description: Shown around photos set to Whole photo, plain background.

settings.title: Show date taken
settings.description: A small caption in the bottom right corner.

settings.title: Maximum photo size
settings.description: Photos download at your screen size up to this limit on the long side.

settings.title: When a photo is too large
settings.description: Kiosk Satellite limits a screensaver page to 512 KB, and a crossfade holds two photos. Detailed photos that do not fit are requested again smaller or with stronger compression. Cut transition makes this rare.
